senses.gloss: f. (נזה) sprinkling of the blood of sacrifices, of the water of purification upon the unclean.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:1">Zeb. V, 1</cite> <he>ודמן טעון ה׳ וכ׳</he> and their blood must be sprinkled on the space between the bars &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:4:7">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵈ</cite> top <he>הַזָּיָיתיֹ כשרה</he> the rite of sprinkling which he performed is valid.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 6:2">Pes. VI, 2</cite> <he>הזאה תוכיח</he> (Y. ed. <he>הזייה</he>) let the sprinkling (on the unclean) prove it; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הַזָּיוֹת</he>, <he>הַזָּאוֹת</he>. Y. Yoma V, 42ᵈ top. Bab.
